description: Opens a fiche for someone before any exchange has happened. An address the account already holds returns that contact as it stands, so calling it twice keeps one fiche.

contact_title.description: Their role there, for example "Directrice generale".

email.description: Their email address, which identifies the fiche.

language.description: The language to write to them in, as a code such as "fr", "en" or "mg".

phone.description: Their phone number, as they gave it.

name: create_contact
title: Open a contact fiche
